description: S-L1 Q03 honest verification tiers (SS N-62) plus Q-L1-16(a) respell single_pass -> single. Writers stop stamping two_pass_verified on rows nothing double-checked: only rows an independent re-derivation compared through two_pass_verdict keep two_pass_verified; `classical_match` ONLY where a check compares against a classical reference table or constant the value could fail (ashtakavarga's 337 total; mudda's nakshatra-lord table chain) and `two_pass_verified` ONLY for a second implementation compared with a tolerance; bounds / plausibility / same-arithmetic / tautological-membership checks earn `single` (ga_strength shadbala, ga_tajaka varsha, ga_sade_sati duration/ordering, ga_dashas narayana and the yogini/ashtottari/chara_karaka/naisargika membership checks, ga_nakshatra join/pada, ga_sensitive_degree Yogi); per-varga ashtakavarga rows documented_approximation; esoteric/derived extensions computed_extension; sarva-mismatch rows floored; everything else single. Changes ONLY verification_pass_status (no value, no row-set, no category change, expected class changes 0). Takes effect only after the S-L1 rebuild of ga_sensitive, ga_nakshatra, ga_sensitive_degree, ga_sade_sati, ga_strength, ga_panchanga, ga_structural, ga_dashas, ga_tajaka. Not machine-checkable by flip_detector: l1_tajik_varsha_year_lords (not a compared table; 240 canon rows two_pass_verified -> single: the three varsha checks are not a classical-table match) and chart_dashas tier (the detector compares dasha row sets and start shifts, not dasha tier; canonical L1 rows: mudda 240 two_pass_verified -> classical_match, narayana 105 two_pass_verified -> single, and the pre-existing classical_match membership-only systems yogini 175 / ashtottari 65 / chara_karaka 106 / naisargika 40 -> single). Full per-emitter transition table, per-chart counts and reconciliation with the audit (PR #2852, v1.1 section 1): evidence/tiers_evidence_v1_3.json (v1_0, v1_1 and v1_2 are superseded, write-once and left in place). COUNTS: tier changes per chart are canon 19,905, Abhinandan (1c826d5a) 17,410, Kiran (cb73cd3d) 22,089 (all charts 59,404); v1.2 and earlier understated Abhinandan and Kiran by 8,240 each (rows currently `single` that also change tier: ashtakavarga bindu / bindu_sign single -> classical_match 960, per-varga single -> documented_approximation 7,280). The Abhinandan and Kiran figures are INFERRED from production counts and the writers' tier emission, NOT from a run; the canonical figures are the derived ones. Rebuilding Abhinandan/Kiran also appears one varga (D30: +480 bindu_per_varga, +40 pinda_sarva_per_varga) as row-set 'appeared' changes. ORDERING: migration 1254 must be applied BEFORE the ga_sensitive rebuild (runbook W4); external_computation_required (Placidus cusps absent) and skipped_malformed_source are not in 1254's conjunct (a) list, so charts without Placidus cusps are out of scope of S-L1 and S-L1b (by name) must make conjunct (a) admit external_computation_required (and decide skipped_malformed_source) before any such chart is built; it cannot fire on the three current charts (all carry cusps). J1 items: ashtakavarga 337 / sum-of-seven (kept classical_match) verifies the tables, not the chart-specific bindus; the upagraha two_pass_verified comparison has partial authorship independence (the in-repo BPHS algebra is documented as matching drik.py) and shares the Sun longitude input with PyJHora (a Sun error is invisible to it).

may_change.expected_direction: verification_pass_status only. Abhinandan (1c826d5a): 17,410 (INFERRED from production counts + writer emission, not run) = 9,170 rows currently two_pass_verified / single_pass / classical_match PLUS 8,240 rows currently `single` that change tier (ashtakavarga_bindu 480 and ashtakavarga_bindu_sign 480 single->classical_match; ashtakavarga_bindu_per_varga 6,720 and ashtakavarga_pinda_sarva_per_varga 560 single->documented_approximation). After the rebuild canonical tiers: two_pass_verified 265, classical_match 960, documented_approximation 7,800, computed_extension 35, floored 85, single 11,025. A rebuild of Abhinandan/Kiran also appears D30 (480 bindu_per_varga + 40 pinda_sarva_per_varga rows per chart): row-set changes, not tier changes.
